notes:
New Features:

+ Adds passive cross-Site HLS playback diagnostics for Adult-TV-Channels.com, Adult-TV-Channels.click, FuckFlix, OXAX and Guljaj.

+ During real playback, Adult TV Test schedules one bounded manifest-only sample per minute and logs HTTP latency, media sequence, segment count, last-segment path, stale-manifest count, ENDLIST state and Kodi player/cache state.

Improvements:

+ The diagnostic does not proxy playback or download media segments and is skipped during Channel Status and Simple IPTV checks.

+ Rotating stream URLs are stored only in a local temporary state file and query values are masked in log output.
